slides.heading: INTERVIEW SETUP
slides.subheading: Light the subject brighter than the background.

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Interview lighting prioritizes clarity and flattering skin—interviews are unforgiving.
Use a soft key at 45°, a gentle fill, and a subtle backlight.
Keep the background slightly darker than the subject.

slides.heading: INTERVIEW LAYOUT
slides.caption: Soft key at 45°, fill to taste, backlight for separation, practicals for depth.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Use negative fill on the far side for dimension.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Lighting the background brighter than the subject.
